manifestations.invariant: When a loan is recalled during outbound transit, its original slot is restored and its insurance rider is released exactly once, and treatment blocks any outbound departure.

contract_bindings.quote: The conservation registrar allows outbound movement only after treatment clearance has been recorded.
The recall acceptance test identifies the exhibit slot that was occupied before dispatch and records the insurance rider involved in the case.
